title: ROI, net benefit, and benefit-realization analysis
primary_chapter_title: Lifecycle Cost, Pricing, and Benefit Realization
purpose: Calculates gross and risk-adjusted benefits, total cost, net benefit, ROI, payback period, and the effect of realization probability and attribution assumptions.
input: `Benefits` sheet with benefit item, gross annual amount, realization probability, attributable fraction, start/end year; `Costs` sheet with one-time and recurring costs; `Parameters` sheet with horizon and discount rate.
outputs: Annual cash-flow table, gross and realized benefit summaries, ROI and payback metrics, cumulative net-benefit chart, and sensitivity-ready output tables.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
